description: This file defines UI components and rendering logic for managing and displaying skills in a web application, including skill details, status, and ClawHub integration.

methods.name: safeExternalHref
methods.description: Generates a safe external URL or null if input is undefined.

methods.name: renderSkills
methods.description: Main function to render the skills section, including filtering, status tabs, ClawHub integration, and skill details.

methods.name: renderClawHubResults
methods.description: Renders the list of ClawHub search results.

methods.name: renderClawHubDetailDialog
methods.description: Renders a modal dialog with detailed information about a ClawHub skill.

methods.name: renderSkill
methods.description: Renders a clickable list item for a skill with status indicator and toggle.

methods.name: renderSkillDetail
methods.description: Renders detailed view of a specific skill, including description, status, install options, and API key management.
